text:
maria: Quick follow-up from the token-validation postmortem — I sketched a short remediation tracker and some owners. Please ack and drop ETAs.

ashok: ack. I'll take the token validation hardening item.

dan: +1 from me, will own the audit-logging gaps.

maria: action list I put together: 
- A1: add stricter token signature checks in auth-service (owner: ashok, ETA: 2w)
- A2: config-driven fallback policy for stale tokens so clients get 401+retry guidance (owner: dan, ETA: 1w)
- A3: audit log sampling increase for auth flows for 30d (owner: dan, ETA: 3d)
- A4: secrets rotation verification playbook and a CI job to validate rotations (owner: leah, ETA: 3w)
- A5: surface token validation failures to alerting dashboard and runbook linking (owner: tj, ETA: 1w)

leah: noted. I'll draft the rotation verification CI job today — will post config snippet in a follow-up.
tj: can we add an SLO for token validation latency? the fallback path made a few calls blow past 500ms.

maria: good call tj — add SLO item (A6) for validation ops (owner: tj, ETA: 2w).

ops-bot: Incident 2024-07-11 token-validation: created remediation tasks A1..A6, linked to PM: infra-security.

dan: for audit logging increase, proposing: 
```
logging.auth_flow.level=INFO
audit.sample.rate=0.25
retain.auth=30d
```
This keeps noise down but gives us density to detect patterns. Thoughts?

ashok: looks fine. For A1 I'll implement an explicit sig+kid check and add an integration test that rejects malformed kid lookup. Example test: 
```
POST /validate 
body: { token: "bad-kid" } 
expect: 401
```
I'll add to ci/integration/auth. ETA 2w (2024-08-01).

leah: rotation CI job plan: run in preflight on rotation PRs, verify new secret present across all envs within 24h, fail if any env missing. Draft PR by 2024-08-08.

maria: recurrence pattern note: ops looked at the last 6 months — we see 3 incidents with token parsing or stale keys around the same cadence after vendor cert rotations. Likely root cause: rotation orchestration race + weak validation fallback.

tj: proposal: weekly 15-min rotation checks for the next 2 months (automated job) and a monthly audit of rotation success rate. If success < 99.5% escalate.

dan: I'll create the dashboard tile for rotation success + token validation error rate and add to the security board. Linking: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/security/rotations

maria: consensus: implement A1..A6, enable weekly rotation checks, add dashboards, and runbook updates. Owners to update respective PRs with the remediation tag "incident-1729001234-remediate".

ashok: FYI I'll open the auth-service PR with tests and put it in canary for 48h.

leah: will include rotation verification in the release checklist and add the CI job to the ops repo.

tj: will add SLO and alert thresholds. Propose paging at 0.5% validation-failure-rate over 1h.

maria: timeline recap: 
- A3 (audit sampling) -> 3d
- A2 + A5 (fallback + alerts) -> 1w
- A6 (SLO) -> 2w
- A1 (hardening + tests) -> 2w
- A4 (rotation CI/playbook) -> 3w

maria: recurring incident mitigation: we'll run the weekly checks for 8 weeks then reassess. If we still see >1 incident in that window, we'll schedule a deeper runbook and an ownership rotation for the rotation automation team.

ops-bot: Created calendar: rotation-checks@redwood for weekly job runs (Wednesdays 09:00 PT).

dan: I've created the dashboard and added two saved queries for the team. PR: https://redwood.internal/pull/4821

ashok: PR draft for auth hardening at https://redwood.internal/pull/4830 — tests included. Requesting review from @maria and @tj.

leah: rotation CI draft PR: https://redwood.internal/pull/4842 (work in progress).

maria: please update the REMEDIATION spreadsheet with the final ETA and link PRs. I'll close this thread after owners confirm PR dates.

tj: confirmed my ETA is 2w, will post PR by EOD tomorrow.

ashok: ETA confirmed 2024-08-01.

leah: ETA confirmed 2024-08-08.

maria: great — thanks everyone. I'll run a quick sync next Wed to validate progress. :thumbsup:
